test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 6: Student Reviews and Plans
test_cases.pre_condition: A student user is logged in and has successfully viewed their scheduled sessions on the calendar. The system is displaying the Dashboard Page with the Calendar open or the Course Details page after navigating from the calendar.
test_cases.expected_result: The student's session is terminated, and they are redirected to the 'Landing Page'. All temporary authentication data is cleared, and the system notifies the user of successful logout. The outcome is successful (True).
test_cases.post_condition: The student user is logged out of the system, and the Landing Page is displayed.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Logout button' dropdown item in the navigation bar.
